description:
CANONICAL ticket for the parallel-only AOT-build flake family (folds in fz-go4.42, confirmed same root — see below).

ROOT CAUSE (candidate, code-confirmed as the shared path): every non-coverage AOT build resolves its runtime archive via RuntimeArchivePlan::Sibling -> find_runtime_archive -> newest_hashed_runtime_archive (aot_link.rs:146,225-243), which scans target/debug/deps for libfz_runtime-*.a and picks the NEWEST BY MTIME — unfenced read-shared state across every concurrently-spawned fz2 build child under cargo test's parallel scheduler. If a transient second/stale hashed archive exists (mid-rebuild, or a differently-profiled cargo invocation), a child links fresh objects against an ABI-MISMATCHED runtime archive => struct-layout drift in internal teardown state (Process/heap/pending_dtors, aot_shim.rs) => intermittent crash ONLY under parallel contention, never in isolation.

CONFIRMED SAME ISSUE across both symptom families:
- both are AOT-build fixture_matrix ::build tests;
- both fail ONLY in the full PARALLEL run, never single-threaded/in-isolation (fz-0lm by report; fz-go4.42's trio verified across 80+ isolated runs at two commits, all exit 0);
- both traverse the IDENTICAL runtime-archive resolution path above.

SYMPTOMS (must ALL be re-verified green by the fix):
- opaque_fn_value_join::build — intermittent build/link failure under parallel contention (original fz-0lm).
- a-resource_aot_dtor::build, file_handle::build, file_resource_lifecycle::build — SIGBUS (exit 138) at resource-dtor teardown AFTER correct output, under parallel contention (folded from fz-go4.42).

FIX (correct-by-construction): make runtime-archive selection deterministic and race-free per build — pin the EXACT archive the current fz2 was built against (e.g. embed/resolve the specific hashed archive rather than newest-by-mtime), or fence selection so a mid-rebuild/second archive cannot be chosen. Do NOT rely on mtime ordering.

VERIFY: run the actual PARALLEL 'cargo test --test fixture_matrix' harness (the single-threaded gate hides this by construction) repeatedly and confirm opaque_fn_value_join::build AND the a-resource_aot_dtor/file_handle/file_resource_lifecycle trio are all stably green; ideally add a regression that stresses concurrent archive resolution. Related: fz-go4.22 (matrix-red parent), fz-go4.42 (closed dup), fixture_matrix single-threaded gate.

comments.text: SHARPENED by the fz-go4.42 investigation (6efa9fc16). Concrete candidate root for the parallel-AOT-build flake family: aot_link.rs:225-243 find_runtime_archive/newest_hashed_runtime_archive picks the runtime archive to link by scanning target/debug/deps for libfz_runtime-*.a and taking the NEWEST BY MTIME — unfenced read-shared state across every concurrently-spawned fz2 build child in a parallel matrix run. A transient second/stale hashed archive => fresh objects linked against an ABI-MISMATCHED runtime archive => layout drift => intermittent crash ONLY under parallel scheduling, never in isolation (matches this ticket's signature exactly). fz-go4.42 (a-resource_aot_dtor/file_handle/file_resource_lifecycle ::build SIGBUS at teardown) is very likely the SAME root, manifesting as a teardown SIGBUS instead of opaque_fn_value_join's failure. Suggest this ticket own the archive-resolution/build-artifact ISOLATION fix (pin the exact runtime archive per build, or fence selection) and, once fixed, re-verify the fz-go4.42 trio greens — folding the two symptoms onto one root (north-star reduce). Related: fz-go4.42.

title: Parallel AOT-build runtime-archive race: fixture_matrix ::build tests flake only under contention (shared newest-mtime libfz_runtime-*.a selection)
